subject: Kickoff: GHUM synthetic-human asset for the data platform
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the GHUM workstream. Goal: package our generative 3D human models - GHUM at 10,168 vertices and the low-res GHUML(ite) at 3,194 - as a first-party synthetic-human data asset that platform customers can sample for pose and shape estimation training sets.

What makes this defensible: the models were trained in a single consistent loop on over 60,000 dynamic scan configurations, with 16-dimensional body shape latent spaces (both linear PCA and VAE variants) and a 20-dimensional facial expression space. Nobody else on the platform has an articulated full-body model with hands and face in one asset.

Milestones: sampling API spec by 4/10, retraining and validation pass by 5/15, launch review pre-read first week of June.

Alina - staffing plan and compute estimate when you can, ideally before the end of next week.

Dmitri
